notes.title: "Opening 500 million" October 23 update announcement
notes.notes:
Dear boss everyone, in response to your recent feedback, we have updated the game, the content is as follows:

1. Fixed an issue where leaderboard avatars were not displayed the first time
2, fix archive file corruption can not enter the game issue
3. Fixed the problem that the black screen could not enter the game after the logo was played

Thank you for your understanding and support. I wish you both a fruitful career and love!

notes.title: Update Announcement on October 19th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you for your support. Based on your feedback, we have made some optimizations to the game

The content of this update is as follows:
1. Fixed the issue of some players getting stuck between chapters 3-4 and those getting stuck after entering investment quotas. In the event of an error, it will not cause players to get stuck, and a skip button will automatically pop up
2. Optimized the investment mechanism of Mr. Jia in Chapter 3 and lowered the minimum investment amount
3. Modified the text of the betting agreement options
4. Revised the final floating screen text in Chapter 5
5. Replaced the 2K resources of the Season 6 Poetry Language Line in Chapter 6
6. Modified the dubbing and text of some videos in Chapter 6
7. Fixed the display error of sunglasses props in Chapter 2

Wishing everyone a pleasant gaming experience~

notes.title: 《Half Billion》10.18 update announcement
notes.notes: Hello everyone~We have received a bug regarding the fragmented game graphics and the black screen caused by the 2K resource pack. We have completed the fix and thank you for your enthusiasm and attention. We look forward to winning both the boss's mall and the love scene, and have a pleasant journey~
